//: Turbo 2.x defaults to strict env mode and drops any variable not declared here, so these must be listed or they never reach the server/vite processes. NOTE: the `dev` task needs dependsOn ^build because @vibeset/core's dev script is `tsdown --watch`, which clears dist/ before re-emitting; without it, server and cli race against a half-written dist and die with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Turbo only accepts `//` comment keys at the root, not inside a task.
